notes: Every series this system charts ended at now Price history ends at now. Pricing-model lines are reconstructed point-in-time and end at now. Even the initiative cone, which looks forward-ish, walks *backward* from today reconstructing what the book implied on each past date. That is a strange absence in a system whose entire thesis is that a price is a claim about future earnings — and whose pro forma produces twenty-four dated quarters that existed only as rows in a table no chart could show. Nine forward lines, plus the term structure: revenue · revenue_initiative · ebit · fcff · capex · brea
